_what: Prospect Radar history (tools/prospect_radar.js). Per player, aligned with "dates": v = model value as an MNR asset, g = games this season, s = points this season (wins for goalies), c = career NHL games, e = NHL games projected this season, k = peak points per 82 in the model (goalies: save % against league level, -1.5 to 1.5). Keys are n + NHL id. Every date is scored with prospect model 3.
